description: Think twice before you drop. Minecraft mod with 2.5M+ downloads.

mods.name: DropConfirm
mods.description: Think twice before you drop. Adds a confirmation prompt when dropping items.

releases.notes:
This update replaces the config library with a built-in settings screen and adds a searchable item picker.

  * The settings screen is now built into the mod, so YetAnotherConfigLib and UniLib are no longer required.
  * Kotlin for Forge is no longer required either. The Kotlin runtime is bundled with the mod.
  * The item list is edited with a searchable picker instead of typing item IDs.
  * A new keybind (unbound by default) adds or removes the item you are holding as an exact item, so a specific named or enchanted item can be listed without affecting others of the same type.
  * The confirmation popup now shows an item's custom name and colour.

## Dependencies

### Required
  * None.

This is a small update to fix some issues with the mod.

## Changes
* Fix an issue with the mod metadata being incorrect for fabric 1.20.1.
* Fix fabric.mod.json to properly advertise the mod as client-side only.

## Dependencies

### Required
  * YetAnotherConfigLib `v3.7.1` or newer.
  * Kotlin for Forge (NeoForge) `v5.8.0` or newer.
